propositions: Read-only, deterministic metrics for code health are derived from git history and current working tree under a single-sourced, flat hard-cap module-size mechanism (.github/module-size-limit.txt).

module_size_distribution scans src/rebar/**/*.py line counts against the cap and returns count, near_cap_count, over_cap_count, and max_loc; cap_change_events returns list[dict] of commit/old_limit/new_limit tuples from git log of the limit file; churn sums insertions and deletions from git log --numstat; refactor_to_addition_ratio returns deletions/insertions or None when insertions is zero.

Four MetricSpec entries are registered into the c085 registry with lens=code_health, source=git, confidence=high, each wrapping a raw function with a context-adapter compute lambda that pulls repo_root, since, until from context.

Unit tests verify exact-value assertions on module_size_distribution over fixture trees, churn and ratio totals over fixture numstat, cap_change_events returning [dict] for changes and [] for no changes, and all four metric ids present in REGISTRY with correct labels.
